label: Ruff volume

range.endpoint_anchor: ruff index: 0.30 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.50 -> -100 = -0.20, +100 = 0.80 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.30) / 0.50)

region.mask_rule: cheek/neck soft-tissue shell over the zygomatic band and jaw; tissue layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Cheek/neck fur mass as a soft-tissue shell - NOT bone (lion +90, wolf +35). The adult male lion's mane is a discrete shell part, not this slider (spec section 3.4). A tissue-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
